Sattva Ayurveda

Vaidya Sebin Johny’s background brings together Ayurvedic clinical practice, specialized Panchakarma training, and healthcare leadership education in Canada.

He has more than seven years of experience in Shalakya Tantra at Sreedhareeyam Ayurvedic Eye Hospital. Our approach values listening, clear explanations, and personalized guidance that fits your daily life.

Consultations are available in English, Malayalam, and Hindi.

Common questions

Before we meet.

How do I book an online consultation?

Send an email with your preferred times and timezone. Your appointment, fee, and virtual meeting details will be confirmed by email.

What should I prepare?

Have a list of current medicines and supplements, relevant medical reports, and the main questions you would like to discuss. Instructions for sharing health information can be arranged when booking.

Can I continue my existing medical care?

Yes. Ayurvedic wellness guidance is complementary to your existing medical care. Continue prescribed treatments and specialist follow-up, and discuss changes with your treating healthcare professional.

Are in-person treatments available?

Please email to enquire about current options. This website accepts consultation enquiries; it does not confirm appointments or treatment availability.
